hook.title: POV: your *performance review* is due tomorrow and you have nothing written

scenes.title: Dump your *notes*
scenes.before: did the office cleanup thing. like 85 ppl showed up. saved money on the contract
scenes.after: Organized 85 volunteers for a company-wide cleanup; removed 4 tons of debris and saved $12K in contract costs.

scenes.title: Then it *coaches* you
scenes.body: "Add the $ figure." "Quantify the scope." It tells you what's missing.

caption:
Writing your own performance review at midnight is a rite of passage. It doesn't have to be.

I built {flow}. Dump your raw notes in, get narrative statements back sized to the exact number of form lines. Then the coach tells you what's missing: the dollar figure, the scope, the impact.

Example numbers in the video are made up. Your accomplishments are the real ones.

Link in bio. Tag the person who always writes theirs last minute.
